nodes.brama.options.[rozbroj_wyrok].text.t: I disarm the contraption. I promised they wouldn't go back where they came from.

nodes.brama.options.[zostaw].text.t: I leave the contraption in working order.

nodes.brama.text.t: On the approach to Bald Rock, in a crack the light seeps out of, stands a contraption: a frame of metal that isn't iron, a coil, a vortex in the middle. The vortex turns so slowly you have to stand there a good while before you realise it moves at all. Behind it is something that isn't sky. The Being doesn't come down here, since it couldn't care less who tinkers at the gate. The gate works by itself.

nodes.potwierdz_rozbroj.text.t: Your hand is already on the first coupling. This settles what comes next. A disarmed gate won't open for anyone again, and nobody standing at it will get away. After this you leave the harbour, and any jobs you haven't settled are lost.

nodes.potwierdz_zostaw.options.[cofnij]..t: I step back and think a bit more.

nodes.potwierdz_zostaw.text.t: Your hand draws back from the couplings. This settles what comes next. A working gate will wait for someone to walk through it, and those standing at it will have a way out. After this you leave the harbour, and any jobs you haven't settled are lost.

nodes.rozbrojone.text.t: The couplings snap with a quiet crack. The Whirl slows, as if it had recognised something it had long expected, and collapses inward. The light in the crack goes out, leaving a darkness in which the Blade rings once and falls silent. Now nobody gets away from here.

nodes.rysunki.text.t: Brygida's drawings say one thing: there are two couplings, one at the frame, one in the coil. Tear out both and the vortex closes. Leave them and it opens whenever someone wants it to. Brygida scribbled in the margin: "Don't touch it unless you want to know what's on the other side."

nodes.sprawne.text.t: The Whirl keeps turning, evenly, at its own pace. The light in the crack doesn't change colour. You leave the gate alone and climb higher, to where someone is waiting who is counting on it.
